picks.title: Elon Musk’s Grok Releases First AI-Generated ‘Odyssey’ Episode, Months After Promising ‘Historically Accurate’ Full-Length Film
picks.excerpt: Months after Elon Musk promised that Grok Imagine would make an entirely AI “Odyssey” film, the tech mogul has partially followed through.
picks.rationale: xAI actually ships the first episode of its Grok Imagine 'Odyssey', a fresh release that shows where a frontier video model stands on long-form narrative work.

picks.title: Sylvester Stallone Defends AI: “It’s Happening, Go With It Or Be Trampled”
picks.excerpt: The 80-year-old actor says the industry needs to embrace AI usage: "Here to stay."
picks.rationale: A marquee star comes out openly in favour of AI, the opposite of this month's Waititi/Kore-eda/Peter Chan pushback, so the talent debate now has both sides on record.

picks.title: AI Firm Behind India’s ‘Mahabharat’ Series Turns to Indonesian Myth in Cross-Border IP Pact (EXCLUSIVE)
picks.excerpt: The AI firm behind India’s ‘Mahabharat: Ek Dharmayudh’ will develop Indonesian mythology film and series IP with Singhasari SEZ.
picks.rationale: An AI studio with a shipped series takes its pipeline across borders to build Indonesian mythology film and TV IP, a concrete new production deal rather than a panel take.

picks.title: Gossip Goblin's AI Sci-Fi Film 'Gods Don't Give Gifts' Heads To AFM Market For Sales With AGC
picks.excerpt: Gossip Goblin's AI Sci-Fi Film 'Gods Don't Give Gifts' Heads To AFM Market For Sales With AGC
picks.rationale: Follow-up with a new deal: AGC takes the AI feature to AFM to sell it, so an AI-made film is now in the regular international sales market.

picks.title: Hollywood AI-listers: is the technology ready to rival flesh-and-blood film stars?
picks.excerpt: As an AI Val Kilmer stars in the western 'As Deep as the Grave' and synthetic performer Tilly Norwood heads for her feature debut, experts split on whether synthetic actors are close to mainstream adoption or still a long way off.
picks.rationale: A reported look at synthetic performers on real releases (an AI-recreated Val Kilmer in 'As Deep as the Grave', Tilly Norwood's feature debut), with experts split on how close they are to the mainstream.

https://deadline.com/2026/10/gossip-gobl.new_action: New sales announcement: AGC boards the film and takes it to the AFM market for international sales (earlier cards covered the 09-28 Zurich panel and the 10-07 trailer release).
